models.description: Qwen3-TTS 0.6B: speaks in a voice cloned from a short recording (with consent). Needs an NVIDIA GPU. 10 languages.

Qwen3-TTS 1.7B: creates a new voice from a written description ("a warm British woman in her fifties, calm audiobook narrator"). Save a voice you like and the Base model speaks with it. Needs an NVIDIA GPU. 10 languages.

builtInVoices.description: A new voice made from your written description. Save one you like as a permanent voice.

models.description: Resemble AI's Chatterbox: natural English voices with an emotion-intensity slider and a pace control. Speaks in any of your voices (clones, designed, saved) from the reference audio alone. Output carries an inaudible watermark. Needs an NVIDIA GPU.

builtInVoices.description: The voice that ships with the model. Pick one of your voices for anything else.

models.description: Chatterbox in 23 languages (incl. German, French, Spanish, Polish, Japanese, Chinese) with emotion and pace controls. Uses your voices from their reference audio. Watermarked output. Needs an NVIDIA GPU.

builtInVoices.description: The voice that ships with the model. Pick one of your voices for anything else.

models.description: Chatterbox Turbo: a faster, distilled English model. No emotion or pace controls (the model ignores them). Uses your voices from their reference audio. Watermarked output. Needs an NVIDIA GPU.

builtInVoices.description: The voice that ships with the model. Pick one of your voices for anything else.

voicePacks.description: All 54 official Kokoro v1.0 voices: American & British English, Japanese, Mandarin, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese.

engines.description: A private Python 3.12 with PyTorch 2.6 (CUDA 12.4) and Resemble AI's chatterbox-tts 0.1.7, installed from a hash-locked list. Needed by Chatterbox voices (it pins an older PyTorch than Qwen, so it is a separate pack).

engines.description: A private Python 3.12 with PyTorch 2.11 (CUDA 12.8), faster-qwen3-tts and transformers, installed from a hash-locked list. Needed by Qwen voices; also brings the CUDA libraries Kokoro's GPU option uses.
